profile.headline: Data Analytics at Fitch
profile.summary: Data & Analytics team lead with a demonstrated history of working in Data & Analytics with a team oriented mindset. Experienced in the entire process of analytics development from data ingestion to business user review & revision. Skilled in Power BI, Tableau, all products Qlik, SQL (MSSQL), Snowflake, Alteryx, and overall data analysis. The highlight of my professional skillset is the speed at which I pick up new technologies.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: I acted as a team lead and facilitate meetings with clients to ensure there is transparency between the work we do and the expectations of business stakeholders. Some responsibilities included defining, tracking, and updating requirements by both my team and the stakeholders. In addition to this, as an SDG team member I am fluid and will take up the mantle of any role to fill gaps in client needs, such as a developer either on the back end or front end of Analytic development.

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description: I took part of the team at every step in the lifecycle of the data analytics pipeline. These steps included working closely with client SMEs during data discovery, setting up infrastructure for analytic technologies, creating ETL to prepare data for analytic consumption, developing dashboards as per requirements, and presenting the insights to executives. Industry focused on healthcare.
